entity_removed.title: {name}: {entity} was removed
entity_removed.description: The entity assigned to the role {role} of {name} no longer exists. It is logged as unavailable until it reports again or a different entity is assigned in the options.

entity_unavailable.title: {name}: {entity} has not reported since {since}
entity_unavailable.description: The entity assigned to the role {role} of {name} has been unavailable since {since}, longer than the outage threshold of {threshold}. The ledger holds its last value; whatever happened meanwhile is missing from the derivation. This clears as soon as the entity reports a value again. If it is gone for good, assign a different entity in the options.

add_refuelling_receipt.name: Add refuelling receipt
add_refuelling_receipt.description: Enters a refuelling receipt for a vehicle, as `vledger receipt add refuelling` does, and answers with the line written, its UUID included.

config_entry_id.name: Vehicle
config_entry_id.description: The vehicle the receipt belongs to.

anchor.name: Time
anchor.description: When the refuelling or charge happened. Give this or the candidate's start, not both.

from_candidate.name: Candidate start
from_candidate.description: The start of a detected event: the receipt takes its time exactly.

full.name: Full tank
full.description: Whether the tank was filled up.

unit_price.name: Price per litre
unit_price.description: The price per litre on the receipt.

fuel.name: Fuel
fuel.description: The fuel type, as on the receipt.

replaces.name: Replaces
replaces.description: The UUID of the receipt this one corrects; it is replaced whole.

add_charging_receipt.name: Add charging receipt
add_charging_receipt.description: Enters a charging receipt for a vehicle, as `vledger receipt add charging` does, and answers with the line written, its UUID included.

config_entry_id.name: Vehicle
config_entry_id.description: The vehicle the receipt belongs to.

anchor.name: Time
anchor.description: When the refuelling or charge happened. Give this or the candidate's start, not both.

from_candidate.name: Candidate start
from_candidate.description: The start of a detected event: the receipt takes its time exactly.

provider.name: Provider
provider.description: Who billed the charge, as free text.

replaces.name: Replaces
replaces.description: The UUID of the receipt this one corrects; it is replaced whole.

cancel_receipt.name: Cancel receipt
cancel_receipt.description: Takes a receipt out with a cancellation of its own, as `vledger receipt cancel` does, and answers with the line written.

config_entry_id.name: Vehicle
config_entry_id.description: The vehicle the receipt belongs to.

receipt.name: Receipt
receipt.description: The UUID of the receipt to cancel.

export.name: Export
export.description: Writes one kind of a vehicle's L1 as CSV, JSON or GPX into the media folder `vledger/<vehicle>/`, as `vledger export` does — one file per kind, overwritten — and answers with the path and how many events it holds. Exports what is on disk; derives nothing.

config_entry_id.name: Vehicle
config_entry_id.description: The vehicle whose L1 is exported.

format.name: Format
format.description: CSV or JSON of one kind of event, or GPX of the trips.

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: Which events: trips, charging sessions, refuellings or periods. Required for CSV and JSON; not for GPX, which is the trips.

since.name: From
since.description: The earliest event start to include.

until.name: Until
until.description: The latest event start to include.

filename.name: File name
filename.description: A bare name with the format's extension, to keep several exports; empty: the kind's own name, e.g. trips.csv.

recompute.name: Recompute
recompute.description: Rebuilds the derivation on disk (L1) from the raw log, the receipts and the configuration, for one vehicle or charge point or for all of them. Capture goes on while it runs.

config_entry_id.name: Vehicle or charge point
config_entry_id.description: Which one to recompute; empty: all of them.

common.summary_message: The entity Waiting for a receipt lists them.

kind_required.message: An export as {format} needs a kind of event.

kind_not_for_gpx.message: GPX is the trips; it takes no kind ({kind} given).

bad_filename.message: {filename} is not a bare file name ending in .{format}.

path_not_allowed.message: Home Assistant does not allow writing to {path}.

no_l1.message: {name} has no L1 to export yet; vledger.recompute derives it.

no_media_dir.message: This instance has no media directory to export into.

not_a_vehicle.message: {entry} is a charge point; receipts belong to a vehicle.

entry_not_loaded.message: No loaded vehicle or charge point has the entry {entry}.
